title: HIIT Fire Assist UX/UI
summary: A UX case study for a round smartwatch workout app meant to be used mid-exercise, with as little looking as possible. It moves from user needs, a persona and a look at Apple Fitness+ and Strava to a task map, then four screens: a mode picker that splits the watch face into wedges, a mode overview, an exercise screen with a green progress ring and an animated figure, and a session summary of calories, time, sets, heart rate and VO2 max.

title: YouTube Music UX/UI Redesign Case Study
summary: A redesign case study of YouTube Music on mobile. A journey map and an effort-against-impact priority matrix lead into numbered problems, each shown before and after on dark screens: readable, in-sync lyrics with timestamps, a distinct card shape for each audio type, a History tab in place of Upgrade, radio moved out of the queue and multi-select in the queue. It ends with redesigned home, library and downloads screens.

title: Spotify UX/UI Redesign Case Study
summary: A redesign case study of Spotify across desktop and mobile. After a persona and a look at YouTube Music and Apple Music, each numbered problem gets a mock-up in Spotify's own interface: multi-select with bulk actions on a playlist, tabbed artist discographies with albums collapsed by default, tabs in place of mixed-size cards on the home page, a light colour scheme, and a now-playing bar that swaps the device button for add to playlist.
